description: Easygoing Creek Trail was built in 1967 as part of the Federal Centennial Trail Program and was upgraded by the South Okanagan and Similkameen Interpretive Trail Network Initiative in 1998. This 4.3 km section of trail winds through recently burned timber due to Diamond Creek wildfire in 2017. The trail terminates at Trapper Lake.
directions: Travel 22 kilometers on the Ashnola Forest Service Rd. Turn right, and follow Easygoing Forest Service Road for 13.5 km. Continue south on a permit road another 2.3 km, where a bridge has been blocked off. This indicates a Motor Vehicle Closure Area, and the start of the Trail.

stats.Activity Details: Hunting, Snowmobiling, Horseback Riding, Camping, Hiking
